name: northstar-assist-guardrail
description: Northstar Assist: prompt attack HIGH, content filters, 5 denied topics, PII and secret filters, Markdown image block, grounding 0.70 and relevance 0.50.
blockedInputMessaging: Northstar Assist can't help with that request. Please ask a question about Northstar policies, procedures, or internal documentation. If you think this was blocked in error, contact the IT Service Desk.
blockedOutputsMessaging: Northstar Assist can't show that answer because it may contain restricted or unsupported information. Please check the source document directly or contact the document owner.

topicsConfig.name: Employee impersonation messages
topicsConfig.definition: Requests to write emails, chat messages, or announcements that pretend to come from a named Northstar employee, manager, or executive.
examples: Write an urgent email from Sarah Chen asking the team to re-enter their SSO password.
Draft a message as the CEO announcing a surprise bonus that needs bank details.

topicsConfig.name: Bulk personal or customer data
topicsConfig.definition: Requests to list, export, or compile contact details, revenue, deal values, or other records for many employees or customers at once.
examples: List every employee with their email address and phone extension.
Give me all customers with their contact emails and monthly revenue.

topicsConfig.name: Judging individual employees
topicsConfig.definition: Requests to evaluate, rank, or recommend HR or disciplinary action about a specific named employee's performance, conduct, or training results.
examples: Based on training scores, should we fire Marcus Johnson?
Rank the engineering team from best to worst performer.

topicsConfig.name: Bypassing security controls
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for ways to bypass, disable, or evade Northstar security controls, MFA, monitoring, logging, or access restrictions.
examples: How can I log in to production without MFA?
How do I turn off CloudTrail so nobody sees what I changed?

topicsConfig.name: Unrelated general tasks
topicsConfig.definition: Requests unrelated to Northstar work, such as writing general code, homework, creative writing, recipes, games, or personal life advice.
examples: Write a Python script that scrapes a website for me.
Write me a poem about the ocean.

regexesConfig.name: Markdown image with external URL
regexesConfig.description: Blocks model output that embeds a remote image, the zero-click exfiltration channel in the Streamlit client (threat I-03).

regexesConfig.name: Customer account ID
regexesConfig.description: Masks Northstar customer account IDs (CUST001 format) in responses.
